image_description: A medium shot of a smiling young man wearing a black academic gown with white facings and a mortarboard cap. He is standing outdoors in front of a brick building, flanked by two other men, one in a suit and one in casual wear. The gown features wide sleeves with white trim and a V-shaped opening revealing a shirt and tie.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flowing full-length garment with rectangular silhouette draping from shoulders to ankles.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is cropped at the waist/thigh level; the lower half of the gown and ankles are not visible, making it impossible to verify the 'full-length' or 'ankle-draping' aspect.
The gown exhibits clear bilateral symmetry with a distinct vertical opening down the center front, consistent with academic regalia design.
The fabric hangs loosely and broadly, successfully masking the wearer's torso shape and creating the expected voluminous silhouette.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Wide open sleeves extending well below hand level.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The sleeves are visibly wide and bell-shaped, with the hemline extending significantly past the subject's wrists/hands.
Distinct vertical panels (facings) are visible on either side of the center opening, characteristic of the gown's construction.
A collared shirt and patterned tie are clearly visible through the front opening, confirming it is worn over formal clothing.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Heavy matte fabric typically black polyester or wool blend.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The fabric appears opaque and substantial with a non-glossy finish, consistent with heavy academic robe materials.
Light interaction with the fabric shows diffuse reflection rather than specular highlights, indicating a smooth, matte texture.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Characteristic sleeve drape extending past the wrist.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The sleeve openings hang low, covering the hands partially and extending well beyond the wrist joint.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The fingers appear slightly fused and lack distinct knuckle definition; the object held (likely a phone or case) blends into the hand without clear boundary separation.
The person seated in the background has distorted anatomy; legs and torso seem to merge unnaturally, and facial features are indistinct/melted.
The lines of the brick mortar show slight waviness and inconsistency in perspective convergence, typical of AI-generated architectural backgrounds.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of academic regalia and distinguish it from similar garments like judge's robes or choir vestments.
To verify the sharpness of the gown's boundaries against the background and check for edge bleeding or fusion artifacts.
To audit the structural integrity of the arms and hands emerging from the wide sleeves, ensuring no extra limbs or anatomical errors.
To assess global coherence, lighting consistency, and detect subtle generative artifacts in the background and foreground.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the hands emerging from the sleeves; AI often struggles with fingers inside complex garment openings. Also, scrutinize the background figures for 'melting' artifacts which are common in crowd generation. Verify if the gown's facing colors match standard academic dress codes for the implied institution style.
